data.gender_notes: Awamil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Awamila’ which means 'bright, shining'. This name signifies the light that always surrounds a person, even in the darkest times. It's a reminder that no matter what, the light within each of us will always shine through. The name Awamil carries the meaning “Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awamil usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
